body:
# Leroy Tre Hutchins

# Board Member

![](/media/uploads/2026/08/Hutchins_cropped.jpg)

- When the school board voted in 2021 to ban the teaching of critical race theory and the 1619 project, Hutchins [abstained](https://web.archive.org/web/20260415011456/https:/cobbcountycourier.com/2021/06/hutchins-critical-race-theory/) from the vote.
- In a [news questionnaire](https://web.archive.org/web/20260122160505/https:/cobbcountycourier.com/2020/11/leroy-tre-hutchins/), Hutchins said, “Systemic racism is all around us in Cobb County and Cobb Schools” . . . “The disproportionate rate in which children of color are disciplined speaks directly to these systemic challenges.”
- When [asked](https://web.archive.org/web/20260122160505/https:/cobbcountycourier.com/2020/11/leroy-tre-hutchins/) about security and safety in schools, he said that “bias training” should be “part of this conversation.” He also said, “I am not in favor of campus policing. The focus should always be student achievement.”
- Hutchins [voted against](https://restoration-news.com/getContentAsset/1ffaea6e-4ef8-4aec-969e-0534f1ccddd8/347abc5f-3708-4979-a52d-d9fb8570b282/Cobb-Hutchins-article-on-teacher-firing.pdf?language=en) terminating a teacher who read a divisive book about gender identity to her elementary students, reportedly against Georgia divisive concepts law.
